text: Coarse net, fine decoder: run the net at low resolution, a tiny per-pixel decoder at display resolution
description: Research 2026-11-24: 'Neural Cellular Automata: From Cells to Pixels' (Pajouheshgar et al. 2025, arXiv 2506.22899) evolves the NCA on a coarse grid and renders through a lightweight implicit decoder (cell state + local coordinate -> colour), full HD in real time. Here: keep splat + net at e.g. 256 px per eye (cost scales with pixels), and let display.frag decode the hidden state with a tiny MLP at 1024-2048 px, so detail comes from the decoder instead of the net's resolution. Training: the decoder sees the sub-cell coordinate, loss at full footage resolution.
